nodes.label: AccessControl and Doctor Scope
nodes.rationale: Server-side authorization covers lists, search, direct URLs, and POST; doctor requests are restricted by doctor_id.

nodes.label: Staff Account Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Only admins create accounts; deactivation and credential or role changes invalidate sessions; no deletion preserves attribution.

nodes.label: Doctor and Ward New-Admission Status
nodes.rationale: Inactive doctors and wards are excluded from new-admission search and forms; manual IDs are rejected, while earlier cases and independently active physician accounts retain access.

nodes.label: Last Active Admin Protection
nodes.rationale: The final active administrator cannot be deactivated or reassigned so management access remains possible.

nodes.label: Batched Prescription Catalog Validation
nodes.rationale: Selected prescription items are read from the catalog in a batch and checked again under a lock at final save.

nodes.label: Doctor and Ward Deactivation for New Admissions
nodes.norm_label: doctor and ward deactivation for new admissions
nodes.rationale: An admin may deactivate doctors and wards for new admissions while preserving previous cases and keeping physician account status independent.

nodes.label: Historical Item Pricing
nodes.rationale: Prescriptions retain each item's recorded price so later catalog or tariff changes do not alter prior treatment costs.

nodes.label: Immutable Discharge Receipt
nodes.rationale: Financial receipt content is frozen at discharge so later demographic, service-title, or tariff edits cannot rewrite it.

nodes.label: Treatment Revision Audit
nodes.rationale: Pre-discharge changes require a reason, preserve prior and new values, and detect concurrent edits.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access
nodes.rationale: Staff have distinct duties; physicians may access only admissions assigned to them, enforced on the server.

nodes.label: Single Active Admission per Patient
nodes.rationale: Patient row locking prevents concurrent registration of multiple active admissions.

nodes.label: Treatment Completion Approval
nodes.rationale: A physician or admin must confirm completion; treatment changes revoke approval before discharge.

nodes.label: Batched and Locked Prescription Item Validation
nodes.norm_label: batched and locked prescription item validation
nodes.rationale: New prescription items are validated in one grouped query and their status and tariffs are rechecked under a transaction lock when saved.

nodes.label: Non-destructive Database Upgrade
nodes.rationale: Sequential upgrades preserve existing data and costs; old receipts are frozen using data available at upgrade time.

nodes.label: Active Doctor and Ward Selection
nodes.rationale: Inactive doctors or wards cannot be selected for new admissions, but existing admissions remain intact and physician account status is separate.

nodes.label: Stored Row Prices
nodes.rationale: Stored prices preserve prior costs through later tariff changes; a different item or service uses its current tariff.

nodes.label: Discharge Receipt Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Receipt printing reads frozen discharges.receipt_data; diagnosis and usage directions are excluded.

nodes.label: Isolated Test Database
nodes.rationale: Tests require an empty separate _test database and stop on a populated or production database.

nodes.label: Transactional Admission Lock
nodes.rationale: Prescription saves, revisions, and discharge lock the admission to prevent charges after discharge.
